items.heading: Ubugali with Isombe
details: Key ingredients: cassava flour, water, cassava leaves, palm oil
Whisk cassava flour into boiling water, stirring into a stiff dough.
Knead the dough smooth in the pot.
Simmer pounded cassava leaves with palm oil and eggplant.
Serve the dough alongside the cassava leaf sauce.

items.heading: Brochettes
details: Key ingredients: goat meat, bell pepper, onion, plantain
Cube goat meat and marinate briefly with spices.
Thread the meat onto skewers with pepper and onion.
Grill over hot coals, turning until charred and cooked through.
Serve with fried plantain on the side.

items.heading: Isombe
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
